records.title: EverMemBench: Benchmarking Long-Term Interactive Memory in Large Language Models
records.reason: The full text defines memory tasks and evaluates recall/interaction quality. It does not introduce a memory implementation or measure inference resource reduction; the linked lineage is a benchmark family, not an efficiency technique.

records.title: Topology and Geometry of the Learning Space of ReLU Networks: Connectivity and Singularities
records.reason: The arXiv abstract is a mathematical study of connectivity and singularities in ReLU-network learning spaces.

records.title: Better Call Grep: Evaluating and Improving Grep-Like Lexical Retrieval for Repository-Level Code Completion
records.reason: The publisher abstract evaluates grep-like lexical retrieval for repository-level code completion.

records.title: Shallow-π: Knowledge Distillation for Flow-based VLAs
records.reason: The arXiv abstract presents knowledge distillation for flow-based vision-language-action models.

records.title: From Atom to Community: Structured and Evolving Agent Memory for User Behavior Modeling
records.reason: The full text describes semantic retrieval and memory updates mediated by an LLM, with user-behavior prediction experiments. It gives no inference latency, memory footprint, or compute comparison for the LLM call path; the agent-memory connection is plausible but efficiency relevance remains weak.
